description: Datadog observability platform with an HTTP REST API covering monitors, logs, metrics, dashboards and more.
auth_notes: API key via DD-API-KEY header, plus Application key (DD-APPLICATION-KEY) for some endpoints; Personal Access Tokens and customer-managed OAuth clients are also offered.
gate_detail: Keys are created within a Datadog organization and require user permissions; sources shown do not state whether a free plan or trial suffices to obtain them.
api_scope: Described as a way to access the Datadog platform programmatically, with many resource groups and official client libraries for Java, Python, Ruby, Go, TypeScript and Rust.
mcp_notes: Datadog MCP Server documented by Datadog, with an official Claude connector; OAuth login flow; URL not stated in sources.
blocker_detail: Requires a Datadog organization and keys with sufficient permissions; plan or trial requirements are not established by the sources.

evidence.quote: The Datadog API is an HTTP REST API.
Authenticate to the API with an API key using the header DD-API-KEY .
API keys are unique to your organization.
Personal Access Tokens (PATs) are a credential type that authenticates Datadog API calls.
Install the [Datadog Connector](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/datadog) from the Claude Connectors Directory.

uncertainties: Sources do not state whether a free plan or trial can create API keys.
Webhook delivery and sandbox support are not established.
MCP server endpoint URL is not stated.
